description: The private messages between the CYFR app's main process and the cyfr program it starts (cyfr desktop-serve): one JSON object a line, on cyfr's stdout (cyfr to main) and its stdin (main to cyfr), each carrying version 1 and its type, and exactly its type's fields. cyfr binds 127.0.0.1:7340 before it sends ready, the chooser's address with the run token in its fragment. home names the CYFR selected, the account service's origin approved for it, and optionally the SOCKS proxy and resolver rules that reach it; main answers home-ready naming the same home once its windows keep to them, and only then does cyfr hand a page the CYFR's ticket. home is a proposal until opened, naming the same home, says cyfr committed it: until then a lock or a failure leaves main able to take cyfr's next home, and after it main takes no other. locked says the device locked, naming the CYFR cyfr holds committed, if any, with home's fields: main destroys its content windows and shows the chooser, and keeps to that CYFR, or none. A lock main begins ends at cyfr's next locked: a home or opened read before it belongs to before the lock and is dropped. main sends lock to lock and shutdown to end; the end of cyfr's stdin ends it too. pick-folder and folder-picked are reserved for choosing a local project's folder; folder-picked's path is null when the person cancelled. account_services is the rule both sides hold a home's account service to: https, or plain http for a local CYFR alone (http://localhost, with its port) and only at exactly that CYFR's own origin. A line that is not one object, lacks version or carries another, names a type its reader does not read, or has a field missing, unknown or of the wrong kind is refused with the reason named, by the side named in to.
